about_the_game:
※This demo version includes parts of the prologue, first chapter, and second chapter of the full version of the game. You will follow the perspective of Ji Wang, the protagonist of the game, and experience a campus story from TONO's transfer to being collected by the teaching director.

The demo version has about 30,000 words of text, and you can experience most of the main gameplay of the game from it.

On a day in September 2024, student Ji Wang welcomes his new deskmate: TONO.

TONO's arrival brings vibrant colors to Ji Wang's monotonous life.

The 100-Day Oath Ceremony, study tours, English Festival, graduation... The college entrance exam approaches silently amidst daily routines. Before he knows it, Ji Wang finds himself holding his exam admission ticket at the gates of the testing center.

TONO

Ji Wang's new deskmate, initially perceived as a "humanities genius."

Actually struggles with rote memorization but surprisingly loves joking around. Enjoys collecting pink accessories.

MORI

The class-recognized academic ace. Excels in humanities and math, yet seemingly weak in English.

Loves anime, 2D mobile games, and RTS games. Rumored to be an avid Six Kingdoms player.

LIPERA

Attends Mi'sa City First Iron High School. Reportedly already admitted to a prestigious university, often seen standing at the observatory gate near Mi'sa Experimental.

Struggles with humanities but eagerly learns new things. Prefers physical books over e-books.

Every character features rich branch stories to explore throughout the game!

Liangpi! Roujiamo! And Mi'sa's iconic "Icce Peek" sparkling drink—

Embark on a Mi'sa City journey that begins in one summer and ends in another.

Tap to advance the storyline! Whether chatting, solving problems, or browsing videos, every choice may unlock bonus scenarios!

Dear Visitor, welcome to Mi'sa City.

ImaginaryObservatory is dedicated to creating Chinese romance visual novels (Galgame), aiming to deliver a fresh experience.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows7 and above
  • Processor: Anyone assists Visual Novel
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics are OK
  • Sound Card: Must have one

short_description: "Imagine Future" is a Visual Novel with a campus theme. You will follow the perspective of the protagonist Ji Wang, experience the life of a high school student. The final examination seemed so far away. one day, it was close at hand. Standing at the crossroads of life, what choice will you make?
